item.title: White House Says Trump, Xi and Putin Will Hold a Three-Way Meeting at Next Week's APEC Summit in Shenzhen
item.description: The White House said on November 13, 2026, that President Trump will meet China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin together on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China. Officials say nuclear arms reduction and Iran are on the agenda; Ukraine is not.

item.title: Chris Van Hollen Launches a Challenge to Chuck Schumer for Senate Democratic Leader
item.description: Maryland Sen. Chris Van Hollen said on November 12, 2026, that he will run against Sen. Chuck Schumer to lead the incoming Senate Democratic majority. Schumer says he already has the votes. The closed-door caucus vote is set for December.

item.title: US Intel Says China's Spy Agency Targeted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang — House GOP Wants a Briefing
item.description: The New York Times reports US intelligence believes China's Ministry of State Security recruited a Megaspeed executive to get close to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The FT says officials believe the relationship was romantic. Three House Republican chairs want Huang at a closed-door briefing on November 18.
